lc_person: Mary (Molly) Nolan, New York University historian of modern Germany and transatlantic relations; author of Social Democracy and Society and The Transatlantic Century.
item_person: Mary Nolan, history professor; Wikidata shares the LC authority, VIAF, GND and ISNI identifiers of the NYU historian.

evidence.says: Authorized heading: Nolan, Mary, 1944-. An author email dated 2017 explicitly corrects her birth year to 1944 and identifies 1947 in The Transatlantic Century as an error. The record retains Nolan, Mary, 1947- as an earlier heading. Sources identify the NYU historian and her books Social Democracy and Society (1981) and The Transatlantic Century (2012). LC links Q27999706, VIAF 61767122, GND 131836196 and ISNI 0000000109281302.
Mary Nolan is described as a history professor. P244 is n2012012122; VIAF 61767122, GND 131836196 and ISNI 0000000109281302 match LC. P569 still gives birth year 1947.
The graph's Open Library author identifier resolves to Mary Nolan, personal name Nolan, Mary, with birth year 1944.

Works attached to the graph's author identifier include Social democracy and society, Visions of modernity, Crimes of War and The Socialist movement in Düsseldorf, 1890-1914. Social democracy and society matches the work cited in LC.

notes: The birth discrepancy reflects a documented correction within one authority record, not two people. LC records the author's own correction; Wikidata retains the superseded year. No replacement QID is needed.
